sources.excerpt: Poder Del Alma Fuzz Previous Dark Arts Drive Overdrive Next Pai Mei Fuzz Poder Del Alma Fuzz Poder Del Alma Fuzz Sale Price: $99.00 Original Price: $159.00 Poder Del Alma: Jimi Hendrix’s tone on Band of Gypsys was both fat and cutting. We offer the Poder Del Alma Fuzz to not only recreate those dynamic tones, but also many other great fuzz sounds. It features Volume, Tone, and Fuzz controls. The Fuzz ranges from just a little hair to a roaring, slightly spitty and gated tone that’s awesome for single note lines. At all but the highest Fuzz settings, it cleans up well from your guitar.
